ground_truth: analytical simulator gravity_ai.simulation.physics.step (synthetic, clean, no sensor noise)

baselines.persistence: next speeds = current speeds; radial = r*omega^2 of current speed; tangential = 0; axial = -known thrust acceleration
baselines.ridge_baseline: ridge regression (alpha=1) on the same standardised features, residual targets, fitted on training episodes only

rollout_assumptions: initial ring/hub speed and applied torque taken from the simulator at the start point
known planned torque commands and axial thrust schedule supplied for every step (recorded commands replayed open-loop; closed-loop feedback is not simulated)
fixed spacecraft parameters and dt supplied
velocities fed back from the previous prediction; no future simulator state used
applied (actuator) torque advanced by the explicit motor model (clamp, slew, power limit)
